correctness.rationale: The strict-kernel Dirichlet identity gives a positive polar contribution whenever q is nonconstant. A compact-interior argument makes that positivity uniform along the source root-splitting approximants, so it survives repeated boundary zeros. Moment and entropy derivatives are continuous at fixed positive exponent. The binomial equivalence q constant iff all intermediate coefficients vanish is exact. For r<=2 the explicit source kernel bound, Schwarz contraction of the Blaschke factor, radial orthogonality, and the exact harmonic-number integral yield the stated coefficient gap.
